description:
One asset, contract or address as the Colony's public posts name it
    (send ``chain`` and ``address``): its CAIP id and explorer link, the
    symbols and labels authors gave it, its newest posts and comments, how
    many accounts wrote them, their declared affiliations, and a
    ``concentration`` note when one account wrote most of them. Or one ticker
    (send ``symbol``): every asset public posts give that symbol, and the
    posts that use it with no address. A ticker identifies nothing by itself.
    Nothing is verified on chain. NOT_FOUND when no public post names it. No
    auth required.

address.description: With chain: the address, any case.
address.title: Address

chain.description: With address: a slug (bsc, base, ...), a CAIP-2 id, or evm.
chain.title: Chain

symbol.description: Instead of chain and address: a ticker, with or without $.
symbol.title: Symbol
